goal: Separate runtime functions and evidence classes in Device Passport without changing the 802-URL SEO observation surface.
changes: Added per-function evidence matrix to Device Passport.
Separated specification/official capability, external field-test evidence, and SolQvia real-device evidence into independent columns.
Kept voice direction and SMS send/receive unverified when source data does not separate them.
Added responsive mobile card layout for the evidence matrix.
Wired the matrix into Japanese and English Device Passport pages.
interpretation: No result is promoted from generic voice to outgoing/incoming unless the source separates direction.
No result is promoted from generic SMS to send/receive unless the source separates direction.
Third-party field tests remain distinct from SolQvia-owned real-device evidence.
No record means no evidence record is currently attached; it does not mean unsupported.
next_order: Increase exact-model priority enrichment for GSC-observed devices.
Expand external field-test matrices when stable source data is available.
Expand SolQvia-owned real-device evidence with OS, firmware, carrier, SIM/eSIM and per-function conditions.
Continue normalizing current carrier-only flagship records without adding thin indexable pages.
